name: SPLIT_ILIM
note: splitter current limit; repo gives only the 2.4 A rating (LED_SUPPLY_A). Measure it: it decides the strip-short case

name: SPLIT_ESR
note: ESR of the splitter's output capacitance

name: CORD_R
note: splitter's USB-C cord, VBUS + GND round trip (~20 cm)

name: PIGTAIL_R
note: each USB-C pigtail, 10 cm of 22 AWG, round trip

name: ESP_C
note: capacitance on the ESP32 board's 5 V

name: HARNESS_R
note: three XIAO harnesses lumped in parallel (26 AWG, ~25 cm each, round trip)

name: FUSE_R
note: 0251002.MXL cold resistance; check the datasheet table

name: STRIP_FEED_R
note: strip feed 30 cm 22 AWG round trip plus strip copper

name: PIXEL_C
note: decoupling per pixel on a WS2812B strip

name: PIXEL_PWM_HZ
note: WS2812B PWM rate (datasheet minimum scan frequency); all pixels switch in phase, the worst case

name: SHORT_R
note: resistance of the fault in the strip-short case

name: GPIO_R
note: ESP32-S3 GPIO output resistance at default drive

name: GPIO_WIRE_TD
note: GPIO1 wire to the board, ~5 cm

name: CPL_C
note: coupling from U1's output strip (E) to its input strip (D), ~20 mm side by side

name: DIN_WIRE_Z0
note: data wire to the strip, ~30 cm

name: DIN_VIH
note: WS2812B VIH as a fraction of VDD
